visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a white beanie and a fuzzy beige off-the-shoulder sweater with a black skirt, stands on an outdoor urban sidewalk during the day. She speaks directly to the camera, waving and gesturing with her hands. (2) She holds up her smartphone to the camera, displaying a Google Maps page for 'Freedom Optical' showing high ratings. (3) A series of screen-recorded scrolling frames show various five-star Google reviews and text feedback for the eyewear shop. (4) The scene transitions to the exterior of 'Freedom Optical' at night, showing its modern storefront with glowing signs and glass windows. (5) Fast-paced cuts show the interior of the store, featuring rows of eyeglasses on minimalist shelves and high-tech optometry equipment. (6) The woman is seen inside the shop, wearing a pair of stylish black-framed glasses and examining herself in a mirror. (7) She sits in a dark optometry room while a male optometrist in a white lab coat and blue surgical mask uses a large measurement machine to examine her eyes. (8) Close-up shots of a digital tablet show eye measurement data and text charts being used by the staff. (9) The woman returns to the outdoor setting at night, standing in front of the store's entrance, speaking enthusiastically to the camera with frequent hand gestures. (10) An animated pink end screen appears with her portrait in a circle, social media handle '@uccu0323', and 'Follow' icons.
